_comment: What each Firebase project was verified to expose to an unauthenticated caller, and why.
Checked by tools/check-exposure.py --baseline exposure-baseline.json --all, which fails only
on a regression: a posture weaker than the one recorded here. The known-and-recorded state does
not fail the build, because a permanently red gate for a reason the author of an unrelated pull
request cannot act on is a gate people learn to ignore.
no_rules        an unknown collection is readable — the test-mode rules a project is created with
enumerable      rules deployed, but the scans collection can still be listed by anyone
readable_by_id  single-document reads only; enumeration denied
Three of these four entries are worse than they should be, and none of them can be fixed from
this repository: closing them is a console action or a deploy credential, both of which need a
person. Tighten an entry the moment its project improves — an improvement is reported, not
silently accepted, precisely so the gain gets held.

projects.note: The target state, and proof it is reachable without FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Whatever was done here is the pattern for the other three.

34 stored scans listable unauthenticated, carrying email, client_name and domain. firestore.rules in this repo denies list and would close it; it is not what is deployed. Blocked on FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT or a console paste.
23 stored documents listable unauthenticated. Review-only product; flagged, not changed from here.
An unknown collection answers 404: this project still carries the rules it was created with. 25 stored documents. The worst posture in the fleet, and its repository has a rules file ready to deploy.
